question: Should official macOS releases be intentionally blocked when the private Apple notarization profile is missing or Apple ticket verification is unavailable?
rationale: This is a deliberate operator and release-availability policy change, not a mechanical correctness question; automation cannot decide the acceptable tradeoff between notarized distribution and the ability to ship during an Apple-service outage.

options.title: Adopt fail-closed notarization
options.body: Approve the PR’s policy after confirming the managed release environment has the private profile and operators accept Apple availability as a required release dependency.

options.title: Keep signing without mandatory notarization
options.body: Preserve the existing signing-only release path and defer mandatory notarization until the release process has an approved fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt fail-closed notarization
recommendation.body: Approve the PR’s policy after confirming the managed release environment has the private profile and operators accept Apple availability as a required release dependency.
